stem:
Padma stands at the same small distance in front of three mirrors at a science exhibition. The diagram summarises the image of her face in each mirror.

Which identification is correct?

options.text: P is plane, Q is concave, R is convex
P is convex, Q is plane, R is concave
All three must be plane mirrors because every image is erect
Q is convex because a larger image always means a wider view

teacher.key_rationale: Same-size erect → plane; larger erect when close → concave; smaller erect → convex. Swapping names, treating erect-only as proof of plane, or linking larger image to convex wide-view are wrong.
teacher.figure_note: Three panels: same-size erect, enlarged erect, diminished erect images.
